tasks.short: Assess the ability of environments to naturally remove or reduce conventional or emerging contaminants from air, water, or soil.

steps.what: Assess conventional and emerging contaminants in the samples
Judge the ability of environments to naturally remove them
See whether water can reduce what the samples still show
Tell the engineer the assessment of that environment

tasks.design: She reads the samples, judges whether the environment can naturally remove or reduce the contaminants, checks water on site, and tells the engineer. No separate removal log is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The samples and the environment are on the site. A wrong call on contaminants can harm people, and the engineer still needs her assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the assessment. A drawing check or a test-result report is a different task.
tasks.still_hard: A sample that does not match the site, and a water path she cannot see from the reading.
tasks.human_edge: She stops when the contaminant reading does not match what the environment can actually remove.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still assesses the samples and the environment, and she still tells the engineer.

reach.task: Hear the assessment and decide what the site does next
reach.learn: Whether the water reading matches the samples she assessed

evidence.claim: Judging whether an environment can naturally remove or reduce contaminants stays with the technician who reads the samples and the site.

assumptions: She assesses the samples and the environment, and she tells the engineer. That time stays.
No separate removal log is part of this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often the lab already interpreted the samples before she assesses the environment.
research_questions: On what share of samples has the lab already said whether the environment can remove the contaminants?

already_counted.description: She still reads the samples, judges natural removal, checks water, and tells the engineer.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still assesses the environment. A site another engineer already assessed is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop work plans, including writing specifications or establishing material, manpower, or facilities needs.

steps.what: Develop work plans including the job sequence
writing specifications the crew will follow on site
establishing material and manpower needs for the job
Name the facilities needs before the crew starts

tasks.design: She writes the work plan, the specifications, and the material, manpower, and facilities needs herself. No second materials list is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The job and the site set the needs. A specification that misses a facility still has to come from someone who knows the work.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the writing. The digest's report generator is for test figures and map paperwork, not for judging what this job needs.
tasks.still_hard: A facility the sequence never names, and a crew size the site cannot hold.
tasks.human_edge: She says which facilities the plan still lacks before the crew starts.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still writes the plan, the specifications, and the needs.

reach.task: Use the plan and the needs she established
reach.learn: Which facilities the plan still lacks before the crew starts

evidence.claim: Writing the work plan, the specifications, and the material, manpower, and facilities needs stays with the technician who knows the job.

assumptions: She writes the plan, the specifications, and the needs. That time stays.
No second materials list is part of this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often the engineer already fixed the material list before she writes the plan.
research_questions: On what share of jobs did the engineer already set material and manpower needs?

already_counted.description: She still writes the plan, the specifications, and the material, manpower, and facilities needs.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still writes the plan and the needs. A plan the engineer already wrote is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Improve chemical processes to reduce toxic emissions.

steps.what: Improve chemical processes after walking the plant
Watch where toxic emissions leave the process
Try a change that could reduce those emissions
Tell the engineer whether the trial held

tasks.design: She walks the plant, watches where toxic emissions leave the process, tries a change, and tells the engineer whether it held. No separate emissions return is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The process is in the plant. A change that misses where the emissions leave can harm people, and she has to see the trial.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the trial. Annex III point 2 treats an AI safety component in a utility as high-risk, and this process trial is not that component. She still changes the process herself.
tasks.still_hard: An emission path the walk did not show, and a trial that does not hold on the next shift.
tasks.human_edge: She stops a change that does not reduce the emissions she watched leave the process.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still walks the process, tries the change, and tells the engineer.

reach.task: Hear whether the trial held before any process change
reach.learn: Where the toxic emissions left the process she walked

evidence.claim: Walking a chemical process, watching where toxic emissions leave, and trying a change stays with the technician on the plant.
AI safety components in critical infrastructure, road traffic or utilities are high-risk.

assumptions: She walks the process, watches the emissions, tries the change, and tells the engineer. That time stays.
No separate emissions return is part of this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often the operator already tried the change before she walks the process.
research_questions: On what share of trials did the plant operator already run the change?

already_counted.description: She still walks the plant, watches the emissions, tries the change, and tells the engineer.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still walks the process and tries the change. A trial the operator already ran is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate and select technologies to clean up polluted sites, restore polluted air, water, or soil, or rehabilitate degraded ecosystems.

steps.what: Evaluate polluted sites before naming a technology
select technologies that could clean the damage
restore water only when that option fits
rehabilitate degraded ecosystems only if it holds

tasks.design: She evaluates the polluted site, selects technologies that could clean it, and judges whether restoring water or rehabilitating the ecosystem fits. No separate technology list is part of this task, so none is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The polluted site is the place she evaluates. A technology that does not fit the damage can harm people, and the engineer still needs her selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing removes the selection. Clash checks and aerial change detection are different tasks.
tasks.still_hard: A site condition the first look missed, and a technology that fits the water but not the ecosystem.
tasks.human_edge: She refuses a technology that does not fit the polluted site she evaluated.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still evaluates the site and selects the technology.

reach.task: Hear which technology she would select for the site
reach.learn: Whether that technology fits the polluted site she evaluated

evidence.claim: Evaluating a polluted site and selecting a cleanup technology stays with the technician who has seen the damage.

assumptions: She evaluates the site, selects the technology, and judges the water and ecosystem options. That time stays.
No separate technology list is part of this task, so none is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: How often a technology is already ruled out before she evaluates the site.
research_questions: On what share of sites has the engineer already refused the technology?

already_counted.description: She still evaluates the site, selects technologies, and judges the water and ecosystem options.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still evaluates the site and selects the technology. A technology the engineer already refused is not her time, and no step here is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The four judgements stay her week. She gains no right to change a process or to pick a cleanup technology without the engineer.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a contaminant reading does not match the site.
Say which facilities a plan still lacks.
Refuse a technology that does not fit the polluted site.
role.ambitious_version: She still assesses the environment, still writes the plan, still walks the process, and still selects the technology. No remote process change.
